content.title: Etsy (ETSY) Margin Drop and $106.8M Loss Challenge Bull Case on Earnings Rebound
content.summary: Etsy (ETSY) reported annual earnings growth forecasts of 22.5%, outpacing the broader US market’s expected 15.7% per year. However, net profit margins slipped to 6.4% from 9.2% last year, with a significant one-off loss of $106.8 million weighing on results. Revenue growth is forecast at 4.9% per year, lagging behind the US market average of 10.3%. The company’s share price of $61.93 remains considerably below its fair value estimate of $119.31.
